changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate entries and normalized model names to consistent formatting. Combined dataset entries ('WEBQUESTIONS' and 'WebQuestions' are the same). Added PopQA which was missing from datasets list.
Normalized metric names to remove redundancy (EM vs Exact Match) and kept all three metrics mentioned in the paper.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation used in this paper. The LLMs (Llama2, Mistral, Mixtral) are used as generators and attackers, not as evaluators.
No human evaluation mentioned in the paper. Only automatic metrics (Exact Match, F1, Subspan EM) are used for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on improving robustness of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems through adversarial training with multi-agent system. Evaluation is entirely automatic using standard QA metrics. The LLMs are used as generators/attackers but not as evaluators. Metadata extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of duplicate entries and consistent formatting.
